actions.label: Read device state

params.name: metric
params.help: Which reading to highlight from the collector.

actions.description: Reads the current state of a device.

actions.label: Switch a light

params.name: on
params.help: true for on, false for off.

actions.description: Turns one light on or off.

actions.label: Set a light's brightness

params.name: percent
params.help: Brightness in percent.

actions.description: Sets one light's brightness and turns it on if it was off.

actions.label: Set a light's colour

params.name: hue
params.help: Colour as a hue angle in degrees.

actions.description: Changes one light's colour and turns it on if it was off.

actions.label: Switch every light

params.name: on
params.help: true for on, false for off.

actions.description: Turns every light in the house on or off.

actions.label: Set every light's brightness

params.name: percent
params.help: Brightness in percent.

actions.description: Sets every light in the house to one brightness.

actions.label: Set a speaker's volume

params.name: level
params.help: Volume from 0 to 100.

actions.description: Sets the speaker's volume.

actions.label: Mute or unmute a speaker

params.name: muted
params.help: true to mute, false to unmute.

actions.description: Mutes or unmutes the speaker.

actions.label: Switch a speaker's night mode

params.name: on
params.help: true for on, false for off.

actions.description: Turns night mode on or off on the speaker.

actions.label: Play on a speaker
actions.description: Resumes playback on the speaker.

actions.label: Pause a speaker
actions.description: Pauses playback on the speaker.

actions.label: Switch a TV's input

params.name: input
params.help: The input to show.

actions.description: Switches the TV to another input.

actions.label: Press a button on the TV remote

params.name: key
params.help: The button to press.

actions.description: Presses one button on the TV's remote.

actions.label: Apply a lighting scene
actions.description: Applies a lighting scene to every light in the house.
consequences: Each light takes the scene's level, or a level of its own where the scene gives it one. A light added later takes the scene's level.

actions.label: Switch a room's lights

params.name: on
params.help: true for on, false for off.

actions.description: Turns the lights in this room on or off. Nothing outside the room changes.

actions.label: Set a room's brightness

params.name: percent
params.help: Brightness in percent.

actions.description: Sets the lights in this room to one brightness. Nothing outside the room changes.

actions.label: Apply a room scene

params.name: scene
params.help: The name of a scene saved for this room.

actions.description: Applies a scene saved for this room. Nothing outside the room changes.

actions.label: Switch a TV on or off

params.name: on
params.help: true for on, false for off.

actions.description: Turns the TV on or off.
consequences: Turning it off stops anything playing on it.

actions.label: Scene Movie
actions.description: Dims the lights in the TV's room, turns the TV on at the scene's input and caps the speaker's volume. That is the room holding the TV, or else the one called Living room. With neither, it dims every light.
consequences: It touches more than lights, so it needs a confirmation.

actions.label: Feed the pets

params.name: grams
params.help: How much food to dispense, in grams: 10, 20, 30, 40 or 50.

actions.description: The feeder dispenses food now.
consequences: Food that has been dispensed cannot be taken back, so this is never sent twice automatically.

actions.label: Clean cycle
actions.description: The litter box runs one clean cycle, which takes a few minutes.
consequences: The box is unavailable while it runs.

actions.label: Switch a smart socket

params.name: on
params.help: true for on, false for off.

actions.description: Turns one smart socket on or off.

actions.label: Switch the air conditioner

params.name: on
params.help: true for on, false for off.

actions.description: Turns the air conditioner on or off.

actions.label: Set the air conditioner's mode

params.name: mode
params.help: auto, cool, heat, dry or fan.

actions.description: Changes the air conditioner's mode.

actions.label: Set the air conditioner's temperature

params.name: celsius
params.help: The temperature to hold, in degrees Celsius.

actions.description: Sets the temperature the air conditioner holds.

actions.label: Set the air conditioner's fan

params.name: fan
params.help: auto, quiet, low, medium_low, medium, medium_high or high.

actions.description: Changes the air conditioner's fan speed.

actions.label: Emergency stop
actions.description: The printer halts motion and turns every heater off at once.
consequences: No passkey is needed because this action removes risk.

actions.label: Start print
actions.description: Heats the nozzle and bed, then starts the loaded job.
consequences: The printer runs unattended and starts moving as soon as it is hot.
The loaded job is the file the printer last had. If that print finished, this prints it again.

actions.label: Pause print
actions.description: Pauses the current print.

actions.label: Resume print
actions.description: Resumes the paused print.

actions.label: Fan level

params.name: level
params.help: The level, from 0 to 10.

actions.description: Sets the level of a pretend device, a class the hub has no shape for.
consequences: Nothing real changes: the device lives in memory.
